armyRules.name: Dark Pacts
armyRules.text:
If your Army Faction is ^^**Heretic Astartes**^^, each time a unit with this ability is selected to shoot or fight, it can make a Dark Pact. If it does, it must first take a Leadership test before any effects of the Dark Pact are resolved; if that test is failed, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then, select one of the following abilities for that unit’s weapons to gain until the end of the phase:
■ [LETHAL HITS]
■ [SUSTAINED HITS 1]

armyRules.name: Cult of the Dark Gods
armyRules.text:
If your Army Faction is HERETIC ASTARTES, you can include any of the following units in your army, and when you do so their Faction keywords are replaced with HERETIC ASTARTES:

- KHORNE BERZERKERS (see World Eaters)

- RUBRIC MARINES (see Thousand Sons)

- PLAGUE MARINES (see Death Guard)

- NOISE MARINES (see Emperor’s Children)

The combined points value of such units you can include in your army depends on the battle size, as follows:

- Incursion: Up to 250 pts

- Strike Force: Up to 500 pts

- Onslaught: Up to 750 pts

rule.name: Marks of Chaos
rule.text:
When mustering your army, when you select a ^^Heretic Astartes^^ unit to include in your army, if that unit is not an ^^Epic Hero^^ and does not already have one of the following keywords, you must select one for that unit to gain and note it on your Army Roster: ^^Khorne, Tzeentch, Nurgle, Slaanesh, Chaos Undivided^^.


Each time a unit with one of these keywords gains a weapon ability as the result of a Dark Pact and does not fail the resulting Leadership test, until the end of the phase, that unit gains the associated ability below.


RESTRICTIONS
- You cannot select the ^^Khorne^^ keyword for a ^^Psyker^^ unit.
- A **CHARACTER/EPIC HERO** unit can only be attached to a unit if both units share the same keyword from the list above.
- A unit can only embark within (or start the battle embarked within) a ^^Transport^^ if both of those units share the same keyword from the list above.’

rule.name: KHORNE
rule.text: [LETHAL HITS]: Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

rule.name: TZEENTCH
rule.text: [LETHAL HITS]: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

rule.name: NURGLE
rule.text: [SUSTAINED HITS 1]: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

rule.name: SLAANESH
rule.text: [SUSTAINED HITS 1]: Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

rule.name: CHAOS UNDIVIDED
rule.text:
[LETHAL HITS]: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
[SUSTAINED HITS 1]: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

Eye of the Gods.name: EYE OF THE GODS
Eye of the Gods.when: Fight phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from your army (excluding DAMNED, DAEMON and EPIC HERO units) destroys a enemy unit.
Eye of the Gods.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER model in that unit.
Eye of the Gods.effect: Until the end of the battle, add 1 to the Move, Toughness and Wounds characteristics of that CHARACTER model, and add 1 to the Attacks. Strength and Damage characteristics of that CHARACTER model’s melee weapons.
Eye of the Gods.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from your army (excluding DAMNED, DAEMON and EPIC HERO units) destroys a enemy unit.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER model in that unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the battle, add 1 to the Move, Toughness and Wounds characteristics of that CHARACTER model, and add 1 to the Attacks. Strength and Damage characteristics of that CHARACTER model’s melee weapons.
Eye of the Gods.flavour: The eyes of the Dark Gods fall upon those who slaughter in their name.

Eternal Hate.name: ETERNAL HATE
Eternal Hate.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Eternal Hate.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Eternal Hate.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if it is a KHORNE unit: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Eternal Hate.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if it is a KHORNE unit: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Eternal Hate.flavour: The Blood God’s thirst can never be slaked.

Profane Zeal.name: PROFANE ZEAL
Profane Zeal.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Profane Zeal.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHAOS UNDIVIDED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Profane Zeal.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
Profane Zeal.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHAOS UNDIVIDED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
Profane Zeal.flavour: Those Heretic Astartes sworn to the service of the Dark Gods display zeal through violence.

Skinshift.name: SKINSHIFT
Skinshift.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.
Skinshift.effect: One model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds. In addition, if your unit is a TZEENTCH unit below its Starting Strength, one destroyed model (excluding CHARACTER models) is returned to your unit with its full wounds remaining.
Skinshift.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.

EFFECT: One model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds. In addition, if your unit is a TZEENTCH unit below its Starting Strength, one destroyed model (excluding CHARACTER models) is returned to your unit with its full wounds remaining.
Skinshift.flavour: Those who offer praise to the God of Change may gam the benefits of his mutagenic powers.

Torpefying Refrain.name: TORPEFYING REFRAIN
Torpefying Refrain.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.
Torpefying Refrain.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit is a SLAANESH unit, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.
Torpefying Refrain.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit is a SLAANESH unit, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.
Torpefying Refrain.flavour: As these warriors traverse the battlefield, an unnatural symphony of hypnotic music accompanies their every move, stupefying their enemies.

Festering Miasma.name: FESTERING MIASMA
Festering Miasma.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Festering Miasma.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Festering Miasma.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability. In addition, if your unit is a NURGLE unit, it can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
Festering Miasma.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability. In addition, if your unit is a NURGLE unit, it can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
Festering Miasma.flavour: A roiling storm of warp energy obscures the Heretic Astartes, leaving their foes shooting at indistinct shadows.

enhancements.name: Talisman of Burning Blood
enhancements.text: Add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons. Each time the bearer’s unit makes a Dark Pact and does not fail the resulting Leadership test, roll one D3; until the end of the phase, add the result to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons instead.

enhancements.name: Eye of Tzeentch
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer’s unit makes a Dark Pact and does not fail the resulting Leadership test, if the result of that test was 8 or more, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Orbs of Unlife
enhancements.text: At the end of the Fight phase, roll one D6 for every enemy unit within 3" of the bearer, adding 1 to the result if the bearer’s unit made a Dark Pact that phase and did not fail the resulting Leadership test: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Intoxicating Elixir
enhancements.text: The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. Each time the bearer shoots or fights, if the bearer’s unit made a Dark Pact this phase and did not fail the resulting Leadership test, after the bearer has resolved those attacks, select one enemy unit that was hit by one or more of those attacks; that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

rule.name: Creations of Bile
rule.text:
At the start of the battle, select which augmentations are active for ^^**Heretic Astartes Infantry**^^ models (excluding ^^**Damned**^^ models) from your army until the end of the battle. To do so, either select one from the list below, or randomly determine two by rolling two D6. If ^^**Fabius Bile**^^ is your ^^**Warlord**^^, when randomly determining your augmentations, you can re‑roll one or both of the dice. Duplicated augmentations have no additional effect.


1 - **Cholinergic Accelerants:** Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model.
2 - **Hyperadrenal Infusion:** Add 2" to the Move characteristic of this model.
3 - **Paraneural Reactions:** Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model by 1.
4 - **Supracutaneous Chitination:** Improve the Toughness characteristic of this model by 1.
5 - **Macrotensile Sinews:** Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model.
6 - **Ophthalmic Enhancement:** Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by this model by 1.

Monstrous Visages.name: MONSTROUS VISAGES
Monstrous Visages.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Monstrous Visages.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Monstrous Visages.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Monstrous Visages.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Monstrous Visages.flavour: Bile’s experimental ministrations have left these warriors as freakish monsters. Cursed with clusters of compound eyes, distended, fang-stuffed jaws or myriad other grotesqueries, they are hideous to behold.

Masters Are Watching.name: MASTERS ARE WATCHING
Masters Are Watching.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Masters Are Watching.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Masters Are Watching.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, subtracting 1 from the result if it is a DAMNED unit: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Masters Are Watching.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, subtracting 1 from the result if it is a DAMNED unit: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Masters Are Watching.flavour: Feeling the expectant gaze of Bile’s greatest creations from across the battlefield, transhuman and mortal warriors strive slavishly to impress.

Specimens for the Spider.name: SPECIMENS FOR THE SPIDER
Specimens for the Spider.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Specimens for the Spider.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll. After your unit has fought, if one or more enemy CHARACTER models were destroyed as a result of those attacks, select one enemy unit within 6" of your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If the enemy WARLORD was destroyed as a result of those attacks, each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test instead.
Specimens for the Spider.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll. After your unit has fought, if one or more enemy CHARACTER models were destroyed as a result of those attacks, select one enemy unit within 6" of your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If the enemy WARLORD was destroyed as a result of those attacks, each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test instead.
Specimens for the Spider.flavour: The Clonefather’s agents are always searching for new test subjects. They strive to harvest the bodies of great leaders and champions, dragging them from battle and leaving the remaining foes utterly demoralised.

Delayed Mutations.name: DELAYED MUTATIONS
Delayed Mutations.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit (excluding DAMNED units) from your army.
Delayed Mutations.effect: Your unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then select one augmentation (see Experimental Augmentations). Until the start of your next Command phase, models in your unit have the selected augmentation in addition to any other augmentations they have.
Delayed Mutations.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit (excluding DAMNED units) from your army.

EFFECT: Your unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then select one augmentation (see Experimental Augmentations). Until the start of your next Command phase, models in your unit have the selected augmentation in addition to any other augmentations they have.
Delayed Mutations.flavour: Fabius Bile’s experiments are notoriously unstable. In the heat of battle, new mutations may burst forth in explosions of gristle and oozing gore, many of which are as lethal to the subject as they are to the enemy.

Diabolic Regeneration.name: DIABOLIC REGENERATION
Diabolic Regeneration.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit (excluding DAMNED units) from your army.
Diabolic Regeneration.effect: One destroyed model (excluding CHARACTER models) is returned to your unit. If your unit is a BATTLELINE unit, D3 destroyed models (excluding CHARACTER models) are returned to your unit instead.
Diabolic Regeneration.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit (excluding DAMNED units) from your army.

EFFECT: One destroyed model (excluding CHARACTER models) is returned to your unit. If your unit is a BATTLELINE unit, D3 destroyed models (excluding CHARACTER models) are returned to your unit instead.
Diabolic Regeneration.flavour: Not even death can lay the most vile of Bile’s creations low.

Autostimulants.name: AUTOSTIMULANTS
Autostimulants.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army.
Autostimulants.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
Autostimulants.text:
WHEN: Start of your Charge phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
Autostimulants.flavour: Arrays of subdermal vials inject autostimulants and biocatalysts into the warriors’ enhanced muscles, invigorating them for incredible feats of exertion.

enhancements.name: Surgical Precision
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES model (excluding DAMNED models) only. The bearer’s melee weapons have the [PRECISION] ability.

enhancements.name: Living Carapace
enhancements.text: CHAOS LORD model only. Add 1 to the bearer’s Wounds characteristic and the bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

enhancements.name: Helm of All-Seeing
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY model (excluding DAMNED models) only. Enemy units that are set up on the battlefield from Reserves cannot be set up within 12" of the bearer.

enhancements.name: Prime Test Subject
enhancements.text: **^^Heretic Astartes Infantry^^** model (excluding **^^Damned^^** models) only. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, you can re‑roll the Hit roll.

rule.name: Tyrannical Motivation
rule.text:
In your Command phase, select one of the following abilities. Until the start of your next Command phase, each ^^**Heretic Astartes Infantry**^^ unit from your army has that ability. At the start of each phase, if such a unit is visible to a friendly **^^Huron Blackheart**^^ model, until the end of the phase, it has both of the following abilities.


**Huron's Elite**
Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.


**Mobile Marauders**
This unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. 
***Designer’s Note:** If a unit is gaining eligibility to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back as a result of being visible to Huron Blackheart, but after making a Fall Back move it is no longer visible to Huron Blackheart, that unit will not be eligible to shoot in your Shooting phase or to declare a charge in your Charge phase unless it is visible again at the start of the respective phase.*

Hardened Killers.name: HARDENED KILLERS
Hardened Killers.target: One DAMNED unit from your army.
Hardened Killers.effect:
Select one of the following effects:

- Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

- Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

- Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1.

Until the start of your next turn, your unit has the benefit of that effect.
Hardened Killers.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One DAMNED unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one of the following effects:

- Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

- Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

- Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1.

Until the start of your next turn, your unit has the benefit of that effect.
Hardened Killers.flavour: The mortals under Huron’s command have earned their place through bloody success on countless battlefields.

At the Tyrant's Command.name: AT THE TYRANT’S COMMAND
At the Tyrant's Command.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army.
At the Tyrant's Command.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
At the Tyrant's Command.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
At the Tyrant's Command.flavour: At Huron’s order, mortals and transhuman Renegades alike throw themselves into the heart of the battle.

Seize the Prize.name: SEIZE THE PRIZE
Seize the Prize.when: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army has been selected to Advance.
Seize the Prize.effect: Do not make an Advance roll for your unit. Instead, until the end of the phase add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
Seize the Prize.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army has been selected to Advance.

TARGET: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Do not make an Advance roll for your unit. Instead, until the end of the phase add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
Seize the Prize.flavour: After locating targets of opportunity, the Red Corsairs pursue them with shocking speed and relentless determination.

Reavers' Flurry.name: REAVERS’ FLURRY
Reavers' Flurry.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn.
Reavers' Flurry.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
Reavers' Flurry.text:
WHEN: Your Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
Reavers' Flurry.flavour: The Red Corsairs excel in the furious violence of melee combat, butchering outmatched foes in a lethal flurry of steel.

To the Favoured the Spoils.name: TO THE FAVOURED THE SPOILS
To the Favoured the Spoils.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
To the Favoured the Spoils.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.
To the Favoured the Spoils.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
To the Favoured the Spoils.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
To the Favoured the Spoils.flavour: Huron and his spies are always watching and judging. Those that strive hardest to reach and destroy the Tyrant’s foes may earn a greater share of the plunder.

Encircling Surge.name: ENCIRCLING SURGE
Encircling Surge.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Encircling Surge.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that is within 6" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Encircling Surge.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
Encircling Surge.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that is within 6" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
Encircling Surge.flavour: As the fighting continues, these warriors slip away, moving to outflank and surround the embattled foe.

enhancements.name: Voice of the Tyrant
enhancements.text: The bearer’s unit has both abilities from the Tyrannical Motivation Detachment rule.

enhancements.name: Raid Leader
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer’s unit is set up after disembarking from a ^^**Transport**^^ that has made a Normal move this turn, the bearer’s unit is still eligible to declare a charge.

enhancements.name: Dread Reputation
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer’s unit is set up on the battlefield, each enemy unit within 6” of the bearer’s unit (or within 12” if the bearer’s unit was set up using the Deep Strike ability) takes a Battle‑shock test.

enhancements.name: Eager for Bloodshed
enhancements.text: The bearer has the Infiltrators ability.

rule.name: Raiders and Reavers
rule.text: Ranged weapons equipped by ^^**Heretic Astartes**^^ models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability, and each time a ^^**Heretic Astartes**^^ model from your army makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Unfailingly Obdurate.name: UNFAILINGLY OBDURATE
Unfailingly Obdurate.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Unfailingly Obdurate.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Unfailingly Obdurate.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Unfailingly Obdurate.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Unfailingly Obdurate.flavour: Such is their determination to claim their due that these warriors will gladly weather a storm of fire.

Scour and Seize.name: SCOUR AND SEIZE
Scour and Seize.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Scour and Seize.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, that attack has the [PRECISION] ability.
Scour and Seize.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, that attack has the [PRECISION] ability.
Scour and Seize.flavour: If the bounty is to be claimed, the foe must first be purged.

Opportunistic Raiders.name: OPPORTUNISTIC RAIDERS
Opportunistic Raiders.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
Opportunistic Raiders.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6", or up to 12" if it is a MOUNTED unit. Otherwise, your unit can make a Fall Back move. It cannot embark within a TRANSPORT at the end of this move if it disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.
Opportunistic Raiders.text:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.

EFFECT: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6", or up to 12" if it is a MOUNTED unit. Otherwise, your unit can make a Fall Back move. It cannot embark within a TRANSPORT at the end of this move if it disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.
Opportunistic Raiders.flavour: Mobility is the key to victory These Heretic Astartes raiders outmanoeuvre and outflank the foe in order to achieve victory.

Warpcharged Engines.name: WARPCHARGED ENGINES
Warpcharged Engines.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES TRANSPORT or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Warpcharged Engines.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
Warpcharged Engines.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

Siegebreaker Strike.flavour: These warriors have drilled relentlessly in the art of laying down murderous fire against dug-in foes the moment they teleport into battle.

Portal of Spite.name: PORTAL OF SPITE
Portal of Spite.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and has not declared a charge this phase.
Portal of Spite.effect: Your unit has +2 to charge rolls.
Portal of Spite.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and has not declared a charge this phase.

EFFECT: Your unit has +2 to charge rolls.
Portal of Spite.flavour: The warp rift through which these warriors reach the battlefield has been directed toward chosen prey by a vengeful daemonic entity.

enhancements.name: Infernal Fulgurite
enhancements.text: Once per battle, you can target the bearer’s unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP, and can do so even if you have already targeted a different unit with that Stratagem this phase.

enhancements.name: Eye of the Warp
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer’s unit is set up on the battlefield, until the end of the turn, you can re‑roll Charge rolls made for that unit.

enhancements.name: Akshur's Binding Runes
enhancements.text: The bearer’s unit can be set up using the Deep Strike ability in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules.

enhancements.name: Tzagulla
enhancements.text: Improve the Attacks, Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s weapons by 1. In addition, each time the bearer’s unit is set up on the battlefield from Reserves, until the end of the turn, improve the Damage characteristic of the bearer’s weapons by 1.

rule.name: Desperate Devotion
rule.text:
Each time a ^^**Damned**^^ unit from your army with the Dark Pacts ability is selected to make a Normal or Advance move or declare a charge (excluding units that arrived from Reserves this turn) it can make a Desperate Pact. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit and add 2 to Charge rolls made for that unit.


Desperate Pacts
Each time a unit makes a Desperate Pact, it must first take a Leadership test; if that test is failed, the unit suffers D3 mortal wounds before any effects of the Desperate Pact are resolved.

Chosen for Glory.name: CHOSEN FOR GLORY
Chosen for Glory.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Chosen for Glory.target: One DAMNED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Chosen for Glory.effect: Your unit can make a Desperate Pact. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll, and if your unit did not fail the resulting Leadership test when making that Desperate Pact, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
Chosen for Glory.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One DAMNED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Desperate Pact. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll, and if your unit did not fail the resulting Leadership test when making that Desperate Pact, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
Chosen for Glory.flavour: Within the massed ranks of a heretic cult, only a few are marked for greatness.

Selfless Demise.name: SELFLESS DEMISE
Selfless Demise.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Selfless Demise.target: One DAMNED unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Selfless Demise.effect: Until the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, roll one D6 on a 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound after all of its attacks have been resolved.
Selfless Demise.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DAMNED unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, roll one D6 on a 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound after all of its attacks have been resolved.
Selfless Demise.flavour: The zealous followers of the Dark Gods are devoted to the last. As death comes they strike a desperate final blow in hope of reward.

Infernal Sacrifice.name: INFERNAL SACRIFICE
Infernal Sacrifice.target: One DAMNED unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Infernal Sacrifice.effect: Your unit can make a Desperate Pact. If it does, your unit suffers D3 mortal wounds (in addition to any suffered for failing the resulting Leadership test), and until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the melee weapons equipped by models in your unit, and if your unit did not fail the resulting Leadership test when making that Desperate Pact, until the end of the phase, improve the Strength characteristic of those weapons by 1 as well.
Infernal Sacrifice.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One DAMNED unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Desperate Pact. If it does, your unit suffers D3 mortal wounds (in addition to any suffered for failing the resulting Leadership test), and until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the melee weapons equipped by models in your unit, and if your unit did not fail the resulting Leadership test when making that Desperate Pact, until the end of the phase, improve the Strength characteristic of those weapons by 1 as well.
Infernal Sacrifice.flavour: Those in thrall to the Dark Gods will gladly sacrifice their lives to draw the eye of their darkling patrons.

Crazed Focus.name: CRAZED FOCUS
Crazed Focus.target: One DAMNED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Crazed Focus.effect: Your unit can make a Desperate Pact. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1, and if your unit did not fail the resulting Leadership test when making that Desperate Pact, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 1 as well.
Crazed Focus.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One DAMNED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Desperate Pact. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1, and if your unit did not fail the resulting Leadership test when making that Desperate Pact, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 1 as well.
Crazed Focus.flavour: Sven in the grip of frothing madness, these heretics are murderous in the extreme

Reckless Haste.name: RECKLESS HASTE
Reckless Haste.target: One DAMNED unit from your army.
Reckless Haste.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
Reckless Haste.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase

TARGET: One DAMNED unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
Reckless Haste.flavour: Consumed by a desire to spill blood, these fanatical heretics hurl themselves towards the foe.

Mortal Thralls.name: MORTAL THRALLS
Mortal Thralls.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected ts targets.
Mortal Thralls.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking units attacks, and one friendly DAMNED unit within 3" of your unit and visible to both your unit and the attacking unit.
Mortal Thralls.effect: Until the end of the phase, while your DAMNED unit is on the battlefield, each time your opponent would make a Wound roll for an attack that targets your HERETIC ASTARTES unit, if your DAMNED unit is visible to the attacking model and is an eligible target for that attack, no roll is made; instead, your DAMNED unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the Damage characteristic of that attack.
Mortal Thralls.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected ts targets.
