Mortal Thralls.flavour: Disciples of the Chaos Gods think nothing of sacrificing their lesser thralls to protect those of greater worth.

enhancements.name: Amulet of Tainted Vigour
enhancements.text: In your Command phase, you can return up to D3 destroyed DAMNED models (excluding CHARACTER models) to the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Incendiary Goad
enhancements.text: While the bearer's unit is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by DAMNED models in that unit, and while that unit is Below Half-Strength, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of those weapons as well.

enhancements.name: Cultist's Brand
enhancements.text: If every other model in the bearer's unit (excluding Dark Disciples) is DAMNED, you can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Warped Foresight
enhancements.text: While the bearer is leading a unit with the Scouts 6” ability, every model in the bearer’s unit has the Scouts 6” ability.

rule.name: Soul Forge Boons
rule.text:
^^**Heretic Astartes Vehicle^^** units from your army gain the ^^**Daemon^^** keyword.
^^**Heretic Astartes Vehicle, Lord Discordant^^** and ^^**Vashtorr the Arkifane^^** units from your army gain the ^^**Soul Forge^^** keyword.
^^**Soul Forge^^** units from your army have a 5+ invulnerable save.

Touch of the Arkifane.name: TOUCH OF THE ARKIFANE
Touch of the Arkifane.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Touch of the Arkifane.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit is selected to make a Dark Pact, you can select both abilities for that unit’s weapons to gain.
Touch of the Arkifane.text:
WHEN: Any phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, if your unit is selected to make a Dark Pact, you can select both abilities for that unit’s weapons to gain.
Touch of the Arkifane.flavour: The blessings of Vashtorr flow through these warriors’ weapons, infusing them with power and mutating them into still-deadlier forms.

Balefire Boon.name: BALEFIRE BOON
Balefire Boon.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Balefire Boon.target: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Balefire Boon.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Balefire Boon.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Balefire Boon.flavour: Channelling the infernal flames of the soul forges, this unit tears through its victims with blows and blasts that melt the toughest armour.

Soul-tally Offering.name: SOUL-TALLY OFFERING
Soul-tally Offering.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Soul-tally Offering.target: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Soul-tally Offering.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
Soul-tally Offering.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
Soul-tally Offering.flavour: Offering up so great a sacrificial victim will surely win favour with the Arkifane, or go some way toward settling the looming debts already incurred to him.

Biomechanoid Regeneration.name: BIOMECHANOID REGENERATION
Biomechanoid Regeneration.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).
Biomechanoid Regeneration.effect: One model in your unit regains up to D3 lost wounds. If your unit has the SOUL FORGE keyword, one model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds instead.
Biomechanoid Regeneration.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).

EFFECT: One model in your unit regains up to D3 lost wounds. If your unit has the SOUL FORGE keyword, one model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds instead.
Biomechanoid Regeneration.flavour: Metal and muscle, wire and sinew flow together, reknitting battle damage with sparking clots of repulsive mutant growth.

Forge-fire Surge.name: FORGE-FIRE SURGE
Forge-fire Surge.when: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army Advances.
Forge-fire Surge.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the SOUL FORGE keyword, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced instead.
Forge-fire Surge.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army Advances.

TARGET: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the SOUL FORGE keyword, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced instead.
Forge-fire Surge.flavour: Warp-tainted motive force and empyric plasma flows through engine and living entity alike, driving them on even as it scours them from within.

Unholy Fortitude.name: UNHOLY FORTITUDE
Unholy Fortitude.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Unholy Fortitude.target: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Unholy Fortitude.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.
Unholy Fortitude.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.
Unholy Fortitude.flavour: Responding swiftly to incoming fire, the bound entity within this daemon engine raises arcane wards to soak up the foe’s fury.

enhancements.name: Wyredjinn
enhancements.text: At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if the bearer is within range of an objective marker you control: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Cybinfernal Font
enhancements.text: Models in the bearer’s unit have the ^^**Soul Forge**^^ keyword.

enhancements.name: Mark of the Soul Forges
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

enhancements.name: Crown of Worms
enhancements.text: Add 3” to the range of the bearer’s Warpsmith, Master of Mechanisms and Enrage Machine Spirits abilities.

rule.name: Slaves to None
rule.text:
^^**Heretic Astartes**^^ models from your army lose the Dark Pacts ability. Ranged weapons equipped by **^^Heretic Astartes**^^ models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability.

When mustering your army, you cannot use the Cults of the Dark Gods rule.

rule.name: Vendetta
rule.text: At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent’s army. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is your Vendetta target. Each time a ^^**Heretic Astartes**^^ model from your army (excluding **^^Damned**^^ models) makes an attack that targets your Vendetta target, you can re‑roll the Hit roll.

rule.name: Twisted Doctrine
rule.text:
In your Movement phase, each time you set up or select a ^^**Heretic Astartes^^** unit (excluding Battle‑shocked units) from your army to move, it can choose to Default to Doctrine. If it does, it must first take a Battle‑shock test. Then, select one of the following: 
- Until the end of the turn, this unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. 
- Until the end of the turn, this unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Never Outgunned.name: NEVER OUTGUNNED
Never Outgunned.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Never Outgunned.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has just been selected to shoot or fight.
Never Outgunned.effect: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.
Never Outgunned.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has just been selected to shoot or fight.

EFFECT: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.
Never Outgunned.flavour: Centuries of combined combat experience enable these Renegade killers to eliminate any target, bringing down resilient foes by targeting weak points or reducing hordes of enemy infantry to bloody mist with rapid volleys.

Vengeful Destruction.name: VENGEFUL DESTRUCTION
Vengeful Destruction.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Vengeful Destruction.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY (excluding DAMNED units) or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Vengeful Destruction.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes an attack that targets your Vendetta target, add 1 to the Wound roll.
Vengeful Destruction.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY (excluding DAMNED units) or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes an attack that targets your Vendetta target, add 1 to the Wound roll.
Vengeful Destruction.flavour: Hatred is a powerful motivator. Those who cross Renegade Space Marines rarely live long enough to regret their actions.

Undying Hatred.name: UNDYING HATRED
Undying Hatred.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Undying Hatred.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Undying Hatred.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Undying Hatred.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Undying Hatred.flavour: Freed from the Emperor’s yoke, these warriors are motivated only by bitter hatred, channelling their ire into every brutal strike: even their final one.

Renegade Claim.name: RENEGADE CLAIM
Renegade Claim.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
Renegade Claim.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
Renegade Claim.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.

EFFECT: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
Renegade Claim.flavour: Renegades do not relinquish their prizes easily.

Corrupted Munitions.name: CORRUPTED MUNITIONS
Corrupted Munitions.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit in your army that has just been selected to shoot.
Corrupted Munitions.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, improve the Armour Penetration of that attack by 1.
Corrupted Munitions.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit in your army that has just been selected to shoot.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, improve the Armour Penetration of that attack by 1.
Corrupted Munitions.flavour: Without traditional methods of resupply and rearmament, Renegades must plunder or barter for their ammunition. Whether seized from the holds of captive vessels or acquired from daemonic arms dealers or xenos black marketeers, these munitions are horrifically effective.

Reavers' Reaction.name: REAVERS’ REACTION
Reavers' Reaction.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Reavers' Reaction.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that was hit by one or more of those attacks.
Reavers' Reaction.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
Reavers' Reaction.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that was hit by one or more of those attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
Reavers' Reaction.flavour: Reacting to incoming fire, traitorous infantry adjust their battle plan without breaking stride, moving to take cover or closing in upon their assailants with vengeance in mind.

enhancements.name: Weaponised Hatred
enhancements.text: Once per battle round, after your Vendetta target is destroyed, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can select one enemy unit visible to the bearer. That enemy unit becomes your Vendetta target until you select a new one.

enhancements.name: Eyes of the Hunter
enhancements.text: Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

enhancements.name: Fratricidal Trophies
enhancements.text: In a turn in which the bearer’s unit chose to Default to Doctrine, until the end of the turn, each time a model in this unit makes an attack, you can re‑roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Empyric Symbiote
enhancements.text: Add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.

rule.name: Iron Fortitude
rule.text: Each time a ranged attack targets a ^^**Heretic Astartes**^^ unit from your army (excluding ^^**Damned**^^ units), if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Persistent Assailants.name: PERSISTENT ASSAILANTS
Persistent Assailants.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more attacks this phase and has not been selected to fight this phase.
Persistent Assailants.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll, and if your unit is Below Half-strength you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
Persistent Assailants.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more attacks this phase and has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll, and if your unit is Below Half-strength you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
Persistent Assailants.flavour: These iron-willed warriors refuse to retreat, even i the face of overwhelming odds. Mounting losses serve only to drive them forward

Brutal Attrition.name: BRUTAL ATTRITION
Brutal Attrition.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Brutal Attrition.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Brutal Attrition.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a melee attack is allocated to your unit, after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, roll one D6 (to maximum of six D6 per attacking unit): for each 4+, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
Brutal Attrition.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a melee attack is allocated to your unit, after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, roll one D6 (to maximum of six D6 per attacking unit): for each 4+, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
Brutal Attrition.flavour: These implacable soldiers weather the enemy's fury before striking back in kind, to devastating effect.

Pitiless Cannonade.name: PITILESS CANNONADE
Pitiless Cannonade.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Pitiless Cannonade.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Below Half-strength, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit
Pitiless Cannonade.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Below Half-strength, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit
Pitiless Cannonade.flavour: These warriors focus their ire upon a wounded foe, combining fire to fell their target in a cavalcade of destructive force.

Point-blank Destruction.name: POINT-BLANK DESTRUCTION
Point-blank Destruction.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Point-blank Destruction.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit’s ranged weapons (excluding Blast weapons) have the [PISTOL] ability.
Point-blank Destruction.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit’s ranged weapons (excluding Blast weapons) have the [PISTOL] ability.
Point-blank Destruction.flavour: Even in the press of combat, the Heretic Astartes bring heavy weapons to bear, shattering fortifications and obliterating enemy infantry.

Steadfast Determination.name: STEADFAST DETERMINATION
Steadfast Determination.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Steadfast Determination.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Steadfast Determination.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
Steadfast Determination.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
Steadfast Determination.flavour: These warriors possess endless endurance and are capable of weathering untold hardships in order to destroy their foes.

Siegecraft.name: SIEGECRAFT
Siegecraft.when: Start of your opponents Charge phase.
Siegecraft.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.
Siegecraft.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit selects your unit as a target of a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll).
Siegecraft.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponents Charge phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit selects your unit as a target of a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll).
Siegecraft.flavour: Veterans of countless grinding sieges, these Heretic Astartes repel and pin down wave after wave of foes with rapid boltgun fire and accurate artillery.

enhancements.name: Bastion Plate
enhancements.text: Once per battle round, when a saving throw is failed for the bearer's unit, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

enhancements.name: Ironbound Enmity
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer makes an attack while within range of an objective marker, add 1 to the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Warp Tracer
enhancements.text: In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.

enhancements.name: Iron Artifice
enhancements.text: The bearer's weapons have the [ANTI-VEHICLE 4+] and [ANTI-FORTIFICATION 4+] abilities.

rule.name: Debt to the Soulforge
rule.text:
Each time a ^^**Heretic Astartes Daemon Vehicle**^^ model from your army makes a Dark Pact, it can invoke its contract. If it does, subtract 1 from the resulting Leadership test when making that Dark Pact and, until the end of the phase:
- Each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
- Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.

Desperate Pledge.name: DESPERATE PLEDGE
Desperate Pledge.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Desperate Pledge.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Desperate Pledge.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit invokes its contract, each time it makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Desperate Pledge.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, if your unit invokes its contract, each time it makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Desperate Pledge.flavour: A daemon construct may beseech the Arkifane for further aid, adding to its soul debt in return for greater might.

Glut of Souls.name: GLUT OF SOULS
Glut of Souls.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Glut of Souls.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit invokes its contract, each time it makes an attack that destroys an enemy model, roll one D6: on 5+, your unit regains 1 lost wound after all of its attacks have been resolved (to a maximum of 6 wound).
Glut of Souls.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, if your unit invokes its contract, each time it makes an attack that destroys an enemy model, roll one D6: on 5+, your unit regains 1 lost wound after all of its attacks have been resolved (to a maximum of 6 wound).
Glut of Souls.flavour: Wrh each soul harvested the bound daemon comes closer to settling its contract and earning freedom.

Daemonic Possession.name: DAEMONIC POSSESSION
Daemonic Possession.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE unit from your army (excluding DAEMON units).
Daemonic Possession.effect: Until the end of the battle, your unit has the DAEMON keyword.
Daemonic Possession.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE unit from your army (excluding DAEMON units).

EFFECT: Until the end of the battle, your unit has the DAEMON keyword.
Daemonic Possession.flavour: Those steeped in techno-sorcery may trammel daemonic entities within mechanical constructs.

Unstoppable Rampage.name: UNSTOPPABLE RAMPAGE
Unstoppable Rampage.when: Your Movement phase or Charge phase.
Unstoppable Rampage.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE or VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
Unstoppable Rampage.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes Normal, Advance or charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features as if they were not there.
Unstoppable Rampage.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase or Charge phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE or VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes Normal, Advance or charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features as if they were not there.
Unstoppable Rampage.flavour: The tortured machine spirits of Heretic Astartes vehicles are driven forward by their anguish.

Predatory Pursuit.name: PREDATORY PURSUIT
Predatory Pursuit.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall back move.
Predatory Pursuit.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE or VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Predatory Pursuit.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6", but must end that move as close as possible to that enemy unit.
Predatory Pursuit.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall back move.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE or VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6", but must end that move as close as possible to that enemy unit.
Predatory Pursuit.flavour: Corrupted Heretic Astartes Vehicles Pursue their prey with an animalistic determination.

Feeding Frenzy.name: FEEDING FRENZY
Feeding Frenzy.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.
Feeding Frenzy.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE or VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
Feeding Frenzy.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) that is within Engagement Range of your units Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, of that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, substract 1 from each of those tests.
Feeding Frenzy.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE or VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) that is within Engagement Range of your units Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, of that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, substract 1 from each of those tests.
Feeding Frenzy.flavour: The daemonic entities at the heart of possessed vehicles hunger for the life force of their enemies.

enhancements.name: Forge's Blessing
enhancements.text: In your Command phase, select one friendly HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE unit within 12" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

enhancements.name: Invigorated Mechatendrils
enhancements.text: Add 4" to the bearer's Move characteristic.

enhancements.name: Soul Harvester
enhancements.text: While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time an enemy unit within 12" of the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6; on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Tempting Addendum
enhancements.text:
Each time a HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE from your army invokes its contract while within 3" of the bearer:
- If it suffers one or more mortal wounds as a result of that Dark Pact, add 1 to the number of mortal wounds it suffers.
- Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

rule.name: Focus of Hatred
rule.text: At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent's army to be your focus of hatred. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a ^^**Heretic Astartes**^^ model from your army (excluding ^^**Damned**^^ models) makes an attack that targets your focus of hatred, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

Endless Ire.name: ENDLESS IRE
Endless Ire.when: Any phase, just after your focus of hatred is destroyed.
Endless Ire.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units)
Endless Ire.effect: Select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is considered to be your focus of hatred.
Endless Ire.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after your focus of hatred is destroyed.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units)

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is considered to be your focus of hatred.
Endless Ire.flavour: No amount of bloodshed can truly satisfy this bitter champion's desire for vengeance.

Contemptuous Disregard.name: CONTEMPTUOUS DISREGARD
Contemptuous Disregard.when: Your opponents Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Contemptuous Disregard.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Contemptuous Disregard.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Contemptuous Disregard.text:
WHEN: Your opponents Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Contemptuous Disregard.flavour: Such embittered warriors as these shrug off hails of enemy fire with arrogant disdain.

Bringers of Despair.name: BRINGERS OF DESPAIR
Bringers of Despair.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that is within Engagement Range of your focus of hatred.
Bringers of Despair.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.
Bringers of Despair.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that is within Engagement Range of your focus of hatred.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.
Bringers of Despair.flavour: Fearful of countenance, these ancient warriors are redolent with warp power and radiate a horrifying aura of might.

Black Crusade.name: BLACK CRUSADE
Black Crusade.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).
Black Crusade.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, and bolt pistols, boltguns and combi-bolters equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability while your unit has not already inflicted 6 wounds this turn using that ability.
Black Crusade.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, and bolt pistols, boltguns and combi-bolters equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability while your unit has not already inflicted 6 wounds this turn using that ability.
Black Crusade.flavour: The Warmaster s Black Crusade grinds ever onwards without restraint or remorse.

Let the Galaxy Burn.name: LET THE GALAXY BURN
Let the Galaxy Burn.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding TZEENTCH units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase
Let the Galaxy Burn.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and change the Attacks characteristic of Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit to 6.
Let the Galaxy Burn.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding TZEENTCH units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and change the Attacks characteristic of Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit to 6.
Let the Galaxy Burn.flavour: No barricade or fortification is proof against the vengeful fury of these hate-fuelled murderers.

Millennia of Experience.name: MILLENNIA OF EXPERIENCE
Millennia of Experience.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Millennia of Experience.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Millennia of Experience.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
Millennia of Experience.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
Millennia of Experience.flavour: Thousands of years of ceaseless conflict have forged these warriors into skilled and merciless killers.

enhancements.name: Warmaster's Gift
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer makes an attack that targets your focus of hatred, an unmodified successful wound roll of 5+ scores a Critical Wound.

enhancements.name: Eager for Vengeance
enhancements.text: The bearer’s unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack that targets your focus of hatred, if the bearer’s unit Fell Back this turn, add 1 to the Hit roll, and each time you select your focus of hatred as a target of that unit’s charge, add 1 to the Charge roll.

enhancements.name: Eye of Abaddon
enhancements.text: While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time your focus of hatred is destroyed, roll one D6; on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Mark of Legend
enhancements.text: Once per turn, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one saving throw made for the bearer.

rule.name: Empyric Wellspring
rule.text:
- In your Shooting phase, when a friendly **HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER** unit (excluding **DAEMON** units) is **selected to shoot**, if that unit makes a **Dark Pact**, that unit’s ranged attacks have +1 **S**. 
- In the Fight phase, when a friendly **HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON PRINCE/DAEMON PRINCE WITH WINGS** unit (excluding **KHORNE** units) is **selected to fight**, if that unit makes a **Dark Pact**, that unit’s melee attacks have: 
- +2 **S**. 
- +1 **AP**.

Infernal Vigour.name: INFERNAL VIGOUR
Infernal Vigour.target: One friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER/DAEMON unit (excluding KHORNE units).
Infernal Vigour.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER/DAEMON unit (excluding KHORNE units).

EFFECT: Your unit heals D3+1 wounds.
Infernal Vigour.flavour: With the unbound energies of the Warp surging through them, this infernal champion heals of their hurts as quickly as the enemy can inflict them.

Fleshy Curse.name: FLESHY CURSE
Fleshy Curse.target: One friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit.
Fleshy Curse.effect:
Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. Roll one D6:

- On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

- On a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

- On a 5-6, that enemy unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds.

These mortal wounds are inflicted by a psychic attack.
Fleshy Curse.text:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. Roll one D6:

- On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

- On a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

- On a 5-6, that enemy unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds.

These mortal wounds are inflicted by a psychic attack.
Fleshy Curse.flavour: Chanting words of forbidden power, this heretic witch triggers a ghastly explosion of hypermutation within the bodies of foes, rapidly transforming them into heaving mounds of gibbering meat.

Wreathed in Warpflame.name: WREATHED IN WARPFLAME
Wreathed in Warpflame.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit is selected to shoot.
Wreathed in Warpflame.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].
Wreathed in Warpflame.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].
Wreathed in Warpflame.flavour: Secondary cantrips blossom out like poisoned flowers from the heart of this sorcerous manifestation, raining mutating flame upon the foe in roiling clouds.

enhancements.name: Touched by the Warp
enhancements.text:
- This model has PSYKER. 
- This model’s weapons have [PSYCHIC].

enhancements.name: Conduit of Chaos
enhancements.text: This model’s melee attacks have [LANCE].

rule.name: Rain of Ruin
rule.text: Friendly HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS units’ ranged attacks have [HEAVY].

Ruination's Bounty.name: RUINATION’S BOUNTY
Ruination's Bounty.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit is selected to shoot.
Ruination's Bounty.effect:
When your unit uses the Dark Pacts ability, your unit’s ranged attacks have:

- [LETHAL HITS].

- [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
Ruination's Bounty.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit.

EFFECT: When your unit uses the Dark Pacts ability, your unit’s ranged attacks have:

- [LETHAL HITS].

- [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
Ruination's Bounty.flavour: As the murderous rain of projectiles redoubles and the fires of ruin burn higher, so the favour of the Dark Gods falls upon the architects of this devastation.

Snare of Fire.name: SNARE OF FIRE
Snare of Fire.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged HAVOCS unit.
Snare of Fire.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
Snare of Fire.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged HAVOCS unit.

TARGET: That HAVOCS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
Snare of Fire.flavour: Even as the foe attempts to escape the rain of ruination, or to close with the foes so cruelly winnowing their ranks, so these Havocs move to establish new sight lines and draw their victims into an inescapable crossfire.

Undying Hatred.name: UNDYING HATRED
Undying Hatred.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Undying Hatred.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Undying Hatred.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Undying Hatred.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Undying Hatred.flavour: Freed from the Emperor’s yoke, these warriors are motivated only by bitter hatred, channelling their ire into every brutal strike: even their final one.

enhancements.name: Pact of Destruction
enhancements.text:
- When this unit uses its **Dark Pacts** ability, this unit can re‑roll **Leadership rolls**.
- In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, if this unit used its **Dark Pacts** ability and if those attacks **destroyed** an enemy model, this unit **heals** 3 wounds.

enhancements.name: Eye Of Oblivion
enhancements.text: When this unit is **selected to shoot**, select one enemy unit within 24" of this unit. That enemy unit has +6" **detection range** until this unit has shot.

rule.name: Prey on the Weak
rule.text:
- Friendly **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY** units’ attacks that target a **battle-shocked** unit or a unit at or below **half-strength** can re‑roll **hit rolls** of 1. 
- When an enemy unit’s attacks target a friendly **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY** unit, if that enemy unit is **battle-shocked** or at or below **half-strength**, those attacks have ‑1 to **hit rolls**. 
This detachment has the NIGHTMARE tag and cannot be taken with another NIGHTMARE detachment.

Plunging Talons.name: PLUNGING TALONS
Plunging Talons.when: Fight phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.
Plunging Talons.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit.
Plunging Talons.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.

TARGET: That HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].
Plunging Talons.flavour: With a last-second blast of speed from their jump packs, the Chaos Space Marines slam into their enemies blades-first.

Raking Pass.name: RAKING PASS
Raking Pass.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
Raking Pass.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit.
Raking Pass.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.
Raking Pass.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit is selected to make a fall-back move.

TARGET: That HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit.

EFFECT: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.
Raking Pass.flavour: Surging in and out of the enemy lines on wings of dark fire, these predatory killers wreak bloody havoc.

Warp-twisted Terrors.name: WARP-TWISTED TERRORS
Warp-twisted Terrors.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WARP TALONS unit ends a move.
Warp-twisted Terrors.effect: Select one visible enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) within 9" of your unit. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
Warp-twisted Terrors.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WARP TALONS unit ends a move.

TARGET: That WARP TALONS unit.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) within 9" of your unit. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
Warp-twisted Terrors.flavour: So hideous and otherworldly have many Warp Talons been rendered by the energies of the Warp, that merely to look upon their approach is enough to scare the enemy out of their minds.

enhancements.name: Pact of Cursed Pinions
enhancements.text:
- This model has DAEMON. 
- This model’s melee attacks have +1 A.

enhancements.name: Shadowcowl Talisman
enhancements.text: This unit has 5+ InSv.

rule.name: The Forsaken
rule.text:
Units from your army with the Dark Pacts ability retain that ability and gain this one.

Each time this unit takes a Leadership test for the Dark Pacts ability, if that test is failed, this unit is Forsaken and, until the end of the battle, this unit loses the Dark Pacts ability.

rule.name: Dark Rewards
rule.text: Each lime a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army takes a Leadership test for the Dark Pacts ability, on a 9+, you gain 1CP.

Inveterate Murderers.name: INVETERATE MURDERERS
Inveterate Murderers.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Inveterate Murderers.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is less than or equal to the Toughness characteristic of the target, add 1 to the Wound roll.
Inveterate Murderers.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is less than or equal to the Toughness characteristic of the target, add 1 to the Wound roll.
Inveterate Murderers.flavour: So long have these warriors fought and killed their way across the galaxy that they have become experts in finding the weak spots of even the hardiest foes.

Low Cunning.name: LOW CUNNING
Low Cunning.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Low Cunning.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
Low Cunning.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
Low Cunning.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
Low Cunning.flavour: Disabused of such notions as honour or self-sacrifice, Chaos Space Marines use every trick and cunning ruse to ensure their own survival.

Next Prize.name: NEXT PRIZE
Next Prize.when: Your Command phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army has Secured an objective marker, or your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army has opened a Hatchway.
Next Prize.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3". If this Stratagem is used in your Movement phase, at least one model from your unit must end that move on the opposite side of the Hatchway from the one it started the phase on.
Next Prize.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army has Secured an objective marker, or your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army has opened a Hatchway.

TARGET: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3". If this Stratagem is used in your Movement phase, at least one model from your unit must end that move on the opposite side of the Hatchway from the one it started the phase on.
Next Prize.flavour: The Long Waris gruelling and requires endless captured materiel to wage. Thus this warband are forever searching for the next cache of arms or riches to loot with rapacious eagerness.

Cruel Execution.name: CRUEL EXECUTION
Cruel Execution.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).
Cruel Execution.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.
Cruel Execution.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.
Cruel Execution.flavour: Veteran killers all, these warriors will exploit the slightest enemy misstep to simply move back and gun their victims down in cold blood.

enhancements.name: Voice of the Octed
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer’s unit makes a Dark Pact, until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in that unit gain both abilities conferred by that Dark Pact (instead of only one).

enhancements.name: Swollen with Power
enhancements.text: This model has +2 W.

rule.name: The Forsaken
rule.text:
Units from your army with the Dark Pacts ability retain that ability and gain this one.

Each time this unit takes a Leadership test for the Dark Pacts ability, if that test is failed, this unit is Forsaken and, until the end of the battle, this unit loses the Dark Pacts ability.

rule.name: Fanatical Onslaught
rule.text: In your opponent’s Shooting phase, each time an enemy unit has shot, if one or more models from one or more HERETIC ASTARTES units from your army were destroyed as a result of those attacks, each such unit can make a Rush move. To do so, that unit can be moved up to 3", but must end that move as close as possible to the attacking unit. When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of enemy units. A unit cannot make a Rush move while it is Battle-shocked, and can only make one Rush move per turn.

Infernal Altars.name: INFERNAL ALTARS
Infernal Altars.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Infernal Altars.target: One DAMNED unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
Infernal Altars.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if your unit is within range of an objective marker, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against that attack. If your unit has the CULTIST MOB keyword, models in it have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against that attack instead.
Infernal Altars.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DAMNED unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if your unit is within range of an objective marker, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against that attack. If your unit has the CULTIST MOB keyword, models in it have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against that attack instead.
Infernal Altars.flavour: Whether heretical fanes unveiled amidst the rebellion or heaped corpses and votive offerings, these ritual foci lend the faithful supernatural protection.

Fleeting Might.name: FLEETING MIGHT
Fleeting Might.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a DAMNED unit from your army makes a Dark Pact.
Fleeting Might.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
Fleeting Might.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a DAMNED unit from your army makes a Dark Pact.

TARGET: That DAMNED unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
Fleeting Might.flavour: For one tantalising instant, the dark prayers of these fanatics are answered by some infernal warp patron, placing the power to slay champions in their hands.

Crude Sabotage.name: CRUDE SABOTAGE
Crude Sabotage.target: One CULTIST MOB or DAMNED CHARACTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Crude Sabotage.effect: Select one closed Hatchway within 1“ of your unit. Your unit can attempt to operate that Hatchway.
Crude Sabotage.restrictions: Until the end of the turn, your unit cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again.
Crude Sabotage.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One CULTIST MOB or DAMNED CHARACTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Select one closed Hatchway within 1“ of your unit. Your unit can attempt to operate that Hatchway.

RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, your unit cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again.
Crude Sabotage.flavour: Using charged rigged from scavenged junk and pollutant runoff, the fanatical masses blast open the hatchways that bar their paths to ascension.

Storm the Bridge!.name: STORM THE BRIDGE!
Storm the Bridge!.target: One DAMNED or CHAOS SPAWN unit from your army.
Storm the Bridge!.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
Storm the Bridge!.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One DAMNED or CHAOS SPAWN unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
Storm the Bridge!.flavour: Seizing their opportunity to strike a fatal blow against those who have oppressed them for so long - and please the Dark Gods in the process - these heretics surge forwards with zealous ferocity.

enhancements.name: Rabble Rouser
enhancements.text: Once per turn, when a friendly CULTIST MOB or FELLGOR BEASTMEN unit within 6" of the bearer is selected to shoot or fight, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons equipped by models in that friendly unit.

enhancements.name: Vox Malevolus
enhancements.text: In the first battle round, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for HERETIC ASTARTES units from your army.

rule.name: The Forsaken
rule.text:
Units from your army with the Dark Pacts ability retain that ability and gain this one.

Each time this unit takes a Leadership test for the Dark Pacts ability, if that test is failed, this unit is Forsaken and, until the end of the battle, this unit loses the Dark Pacts ability.

rule.name: Dark Purpose
rule.text: Each time a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army Consolidates, if it is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, then until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes a Consolidation move, it can move towards the closest objective marker, but only if, after all models have done so, that unit is within range of that objective marker and in Unit Coherency.

Imperious Advance.name: IMPERIOUS ADVANCE
Imperious Advance.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Imperious Advance.effect: Select any number of models in your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the selected models, and each time you select targets for attacks made by those models, they must target an enemy unit that is wholly on the opposite side of a Hatchway from them.
Imperious Advance.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Select any number of models in your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the selected models, and each time you select targets for attacks made by those models, they must target an enemy unit that is wholly on the opposite side of a Hatchway from them.
Imperious Advance.flavour: Attempting to bar the path of these chosen warriors only fills them with a cruel and arrogant desire to crush those who stand in their way.

Malign Will.name: MALIGN WILL
Malign Will.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Malign Will.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Malign Will.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit takes a Leadership test for the Dark Pacts ability, subtract 1 from the result and, if passed, select one objective marker within 6" of your unit. If there are no enemy units within range of that objective marker (excluding Battle-shocked units], that objective marker is Secured by your army.
Malign Will.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit takes a Leadership test for the Dark Pacts ability, subtract 1 from the result and, if passed, select one objective marker within 6" of your unit. If there are no enemy units within range of that objective marker (excluding Battle-shocked units], that objective marker is Secured by your army.
Malign Will.flavour: These warriors' will to conquer and despoil is so great that it manifests through the dark power of the warp into a corporeal blight upon realspace.

Infernal Patrons.name: INFERNAL PATRONS
Infernal Patrons.when: Any phase, just after your opponent targets a unit from their army with a Stratagem.
Infernal Patrons.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army within 3" of and visible to that enemy unit.
Infernal Patrons.effect: That enemy unit must take a Leadership test; if failed, that usage of that Stratagem has no effect (your opponent cannot use that Stratagem again this phase).
Infernal Patrons.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after your opponent targets a unit from their army with a Stratagem.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army within 3" of and visible to that enemy unit.

EFFECT: That enemy unit must take a Leadership test; if failed, that usage of that Stratagem has no effect (your opponent cannot use that Stratagem again this phase).
Infernal Patrons.flavour: Many chosen warriors of the Dark Gods have forged pacts with minor daemonic entities, gaining their insidious aid to terrify and disorient the foe in battle.

Aggressive Strike.name: AGGRESSIVE STRIKE
Aggressive Strike.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that arrived using the Deep Strike ability this turn.
Aggressive Strike.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
Aggressive Strike.restrictions: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.
Aggressive Strike.text:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that arrived using the Deep Strike ability this turn.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.
Aggressive Strike.flavour: Veterans of countless teleport assaults, these warriors burst from the warp already striding, firing and bellowing praise to the Dark Gods

enhancements.name: Manifest Vengeance
enhancements.text: When the bearer is destroyed, if it has not shot or fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if it was destroyed by a melee attack: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The bearer can shoot or fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

enhancements.name: Dark Majesty
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it. Until the start of your next Charge phase, that enemy unit is stunned. While a unit is stunned, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

endlessire.name: ENDLESS IRE
endlessire.when: Any phase, just after your focus of hatred is destroyed.
endlessire.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units)
endlessire.effect: Select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is considered to be your focus of hatred.
endlessire.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after your focus of hatred is destroyed.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units)

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is considered to be your focus of hatred.
endlessire.flavour: No amount of bloodshed can truly satisfy this bitter champion's desire for vengeance.

contemptuousdisregard.name: CONTEMPTUOUS DISREGARD
contemptuousdisregard.when: Your opponents Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
contemptuousdisregard.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
contemptuousdisregard.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
contemptuousdisregard.flavour: Such embittered warriors as these shrug off hails of enemy fire with arrogant disdain.

bringersofdespair.name: BRINGERS OF DESPAIR
bringersofdespair.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that is within Engagement Range of your focus of hatred.
bringersofdespair.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.
bringersofdespair.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that is within Engagement Range of your focus of hatred.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.
bringersofdespair.flavour: Fearful of countenance, these ancient warriors are redolent with warp power and radiate a horrifying aura of might.

blackcrusade.name: BLACK CRUSADE
blackcrusade.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).
blackcrusade.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, and bolt pistols, boltguns and combi-bolters equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability while your unit has not already inflicted 6 wounds this turn using that ability.
blackcrusade.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, and bolt pistols, boltguns and combi-bolters equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability while your unit has not already inflicted 6 wounds this turn using that ability.
blackcrusade.flavour: The Warmaster s Black Crusade grinds ever onwards without restraint or remorse.

letthegalaxyburn.name: LET THE GALAXY BURN
letthegalaxyburn.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding TZEENTCH units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase
letthegalaxyburn.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and change the Attacks characteristic of Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit to 6.
letthegalaxyburn.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding TZEENTCH units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and change the Attacks characteristic of Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit to 6.
letthegalaxyburn.flavour: No barricade or fortification is proof against the vengeful fury of these hate-fuelled murderers.

millenniaofexperience.name: MILLENNIA OF EXPERIENCE
millenniaofexperience.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
millenniaofexperience.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
millenniaofexperience.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
millenniaofexperience.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
millenniaofexperience.flavour: Thousands of years of ceaseless conflict have forged these warriors into skilled and merciless killers.

detonator.name: DETONATOR
detonator.when: Any phase, just after an enemy model with the Deadly Demise ability (excluding TITANIC models) is destroyed
detonator.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from your army that was within 18" of that enemy model when it was destroyed.
detonator.effect: Your opponent does not roll to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by their model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted (if that ability inflicts a random number of mortal wounds, your opponent rolls to determine that number as normal).
detonator.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after an enemy model with the Deadly Demise ability (excluding TITANIC models) is destroyed

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER unit from your army that was within 18" of that enemy model when it was destroyed.

EFFECT: Your opponent does not roll to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by their model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted (if that ability inflicts a random number of mortal wounds, your opponent rolls to determine that number as normal).
detonator.flavour: These warriors employ expert saboteurs who utilise melta charges and improvised explosives to sow destruction.

fromallsides.name: FROM ALL SIDES
fromallsides.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.
fromallsides.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to Charge rolls made for your unit for each other HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that made a Charge move this phase (to a maximum of +3)
fromallsides.text:
WHEN: Start of your Charge phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to Charge rolls made for your unit for each other HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that made a Charge move this phase (to a maximum of +3)
fromallsides.flavour: When the assault comes, it does so swiftly and without warning.

pickthemoff.name: PICK THEM OFF
pickthemoff.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
pickthemoff.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If the target is Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
pickthemoff.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If the target is Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
pickthemoff.flavour: The Heretic Astartes are pitiless reavers, targeting weak points in the enemy line with ruthless efficiency.

coilsofdeception.name: COILS OF DECEPTION
coilsofdeception.when: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army Falls Back.
coilsofdeception.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back
coilsofdeception.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army Falls Back.

TARGET: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back
coilsofdeception.flavour: Some Heretic Astartes are masters of deceit, often feigning retreat only to open fire from close range.

relentlesspursuit.name: RELENTLESS PURSUIT
relentlesspursuit.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
relentlesspursuit.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
relentlesspursuit.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
relentlesspursuit.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
relentlesspursuit.flavour: These warriors stalk their assigned target with dogged determination, reacting to their every move

scrambledcoordinates.name: SCRAMBLED COORDINATES
scrambledcoordinates.when: Start of the Reinforcements step of your opponent’s Movement phase.
scrambledcoordinates.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.
scrambledcoordinates.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield from Reserves cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of your unit.
scrambledcoordinates.text:
WHEN: Start of the Reinforcements step of your opponent’s Movement phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield from Reserves cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of your unit.
scrambledcoordinates.flavour: Employing fell techno-sorcery, the Heretic Astartes disroot enemy navigational cogitators and scramble teleporter beacons.

unfailinglyobdurate.name: UNFAILINGLY OBDURATE
unfailinglyobdurate.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
unfailinglyobdurate.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
unfailinglyobdurate.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
unfailinglyobdurate.text:

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
unfailinglyobdurate.flavour: Such is their determination to claim their due that these warriors will gladly weather a storm of fire.

scourandseize.name: SCOUR AND SEIZE
scourandseize.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
scourandseize.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, that attack has the [PRECISION] ability.
scourandseize.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, that attack has the [PRECISION] ability.
scourandseize.flavour: If the bounty is to be claimed, the foe must first be purged.

opportunisticraiders.name: OPPORTUNISTIC RAIDERS
opportunisticraiders.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
opportunisticraiders.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6", or up to 12" if it is a MOUNTED unit. Otherwise, your unit can make a Fall Back move. It cannot embark within a TRANSPORT at the end of this move if it disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.
opportunisticraiders.text:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.

EFFECT: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6", or up to 12" if it is a MOUNTED unit. Otherwise, your unit can make a Fall Back move. It cannot embark within a TRANSPORT at the end of this move if it disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.
opportunisticraiders.flavour: Mobility is the key to victory These Heretic Astartes raiders outmanoeuvre and outflank the foe in order to achieve victory.

warpchargedengines.name: WARPCHARGED ENGINES
warpchargedengines.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES TRANSPORT or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
warpchargedengines.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
warpchargedengines.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES TRANSPORT or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
warpchargedengines.flavour: The engines of this vehicle or construct crackle with the raw energies of the immaterium, propelling it forward or incredible speed.

ruinousraid.name: RUINOUS RAID
ruinousraid.when: Your Shooting phase or your Fight phase
ruinousraid.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
ruinousraid.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the target of that attack is within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
ruinousraid.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or your Fight phase

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn and has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the target of that attack is within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
ruinousraid.flavour: Utilising their swift transports, these ravagers plunge through the enemy lines to assault key positions.

reavershaste.name: REAVERS’ HASTE
reavershaste.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army.
reavershaste.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. If you select one or more units within range of an objective marker as a target of that charge, add 1 to the Charge roll.
reavershaste.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. If you select one or more units within range of an objective marker as a target of that charge, add 1 to the Charge roll.
reavershaste.flavour: The prospect of riches spurs these renegade warriors forwards. Woe betide any in their path.

depthlesscruelty.name: DEPTHLESS CRUELTY
depthlesscruelty.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
depthlesscruelty.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
depthlesscruelty.text:
WHEN: Fight phase

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
depthlesscruelty.flavour: Terror troops such as these inflict agonies upon their victims with malicious relish, targeting the weakened and wounded without pity

bloodyexample.name: BLOODY EXAMPLE
bloodyexample.when: Fight phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army destroys a CHARACTER unit.
bloodyexample.effect: Each enemy unit within 12" of and visible to your unit must take a Battle-shock test.
bloodyexample.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army destroys a CHARACTER unit.

TARGET: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit within 12" of and visible to your unit must take a Battle-shock test.
