mastersarewatching.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
mastersarewatching.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
mastersarewatching.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, subtracting 1 from the result if it is a DAMNED unit: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
mastersarewatching.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, subtracting 1 from the result if it is a DAMNED unit: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
mastersarewatching.flavour: Feeling the expectant gaze of Bile’s greatest creations from across the battlefield, transhuman and mortal warriors strive slavishly to impress.

specimensforthespider.name: SPECIMENS FOR THE SPIDER
specimensforthespider.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
specimensforthespider.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll. After your unit has fought, if one or more enemy CHARACTER models were destroyed as a result of those attacks, select one enemy unit within 6" of your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If the enemy WARLORD was destroyed as a result of those attacks, each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test instead.
specimensforthespider.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll. After your unit has fought, if one or more enemy CHARACTER models were destroyed as a result of those attacks, select one enemy unit within 6" of your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If the enemy WARLORD was destroyed as a result of those attacks, each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test instead.
specimensforthespider.flavour: The Clonefather’s agents are always searching for new test subjects. They strive to harvest the bodies of great leaders and champions, dragging them from battle and leaving the remaining foes utterly demoralised.

delayedmutations.name: DELAYED MUTATIONS
delayedmutations.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit (excluding DAMNED units) from your army.
delayedmutations.effect: Your unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then select one augmentation (see Experimental Augmentations). Until the start of your next Command phase, models in your unit have the selected augmentation in addition to any other augmentations they have.
delayedmutations.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit (excluding DAMNED units) from your army.

EFFECT: Your unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then select one augmentation (see Experimental Augmentations). Until the start of your next Command phase, models in your unit have the selected augmentation in addition to any other augmentations they have.
delayedmutations.flavour: Fabius Bile’s experiments are notoriously unstable. In the heat of battle, new mutations may burst forth in explosions of gristle and oozing gore, many of which are as lethal to the subject as they are to the enemy.

diabolicregeneration.name: DIABOLIC REGENERATION
diabolicregeneration.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit (excluding DAMNED units) from your army.
diabolicregeneration.effect: One destroyed model (excluding CHARACTER models) is returned to your unit. If your unit is a BATTLELINE unit, D3 destroyed models (excluding CHARACTER models) are returned to your unit instead.
diabolicregeneration.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit (excluding DAMNED units) from your army.

EFFECT: One destroyed model (excluding CHARACTER models) is returned to your unit. If your unit is a BATTLELINE unit, D3 destroyed models (excluding CHARACTER models) are returned to your unit instead.
diabolicregeneration.flavour: Not even death can lay the most vile of Bile’s creations low.

autostimulants.name: AUTOSTIMULANTS
autostimulants.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army.
autostimulants.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
autostimulants.text:
WHEN: Start of your Charge phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
autostimulants.flavour: Arrays of subdermal vials inject autostimulants and biocatalysts into the warriors’ enhanced muscles, invigorating them for incredible feats of exertion.

talonssunkdeep.name: TALONS SUNK DEEP
talonssunkdeep.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
talonssunkdeep.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
talonssunkdeep.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
talonssunkdeep.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
talonssunkdeep.flavour: When indecision and terror grip the foe, their frailties are exposed to the cruelest of lunges.

preyontheweak.name: PREY ON THE WEAK
preyontheweak.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
preyontheweak.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
preyontheweak.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
preyontheweak.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is Battle-shocked and/or Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
preyontheweak.flavour: Suitably wounded, or with the corpses of their comrades around them, the enemy’s faltering cohesion marks them as doomed.

sadisticdisplay.name: SADISTIC DISPLAY
sadisticdisplay.when: Fight phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
sadisticdisplay.effect: Each enemy unit within 6" of and visible to your unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units) must take a Battle-shock test.
sadisticdisplay.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.

TARGET: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit within 6" of and visible to your unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units) must take a Battle-shock test.
sadisticdisplay.flavour: It is not enough to slay. The foe’s allies must understand exactly what horrors await them.

malicioussurge.name: MALICIOUS SURGE
malicioussurge.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army.
malicioussurge.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
malicioussurge.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
malicioussurge.flavour: Pairing unholy power with blistering speed, the full horror of these warriors’ strength is brought crashing into their foes.

horrificincursion.name: HORRIFIC INCURSION
horrificincursion.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that arrived from Reserves this turn.
horrificincursion.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units) within 12" of and visible to your unit: that unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
horrificincursion.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that arrived from Reserves this turn.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units) within 12" of and visible to your unit: that unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
horrificincursion.flavour: Accompanied by a burst of sensory torment, a sudden deployment can shatter the prey’s discipline.

hardenedkillers.name: HARDENED KILLERS
hardenedkillers.target: One DAMNED unit from your army.
hardenedkillers.effect:
Select one of the following effects:

- Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

- Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

- Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1.

Until the start of your next turn, your unit has the benefit of that effect.
hardenedkillers.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One DAMNED unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one of the following effects:

- Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

- Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

- Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1.

Until the start of your next turn, your unit has the benefit of that effect.
hardenedkillers.flavour: The mortals under Huron’s command have earned their place through bloody success on countless battlefields.

atthetyrantscommand.name: AT THE TYRANT’S COMMAND
atthetyrantscommand.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army.
atthetyrantscommand.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
atthetyrantscommand.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
atthetyrantscommand.flavour: At Huron’s order, mortals and transhuman Renegades alike throw themselves into the heart of the battle.

seizetheprize.name: SEIZE THE PRIZE
seizetheprize.when: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army has been selected to Advance.
seizetheprize.effect: Do not make an Advance roll for your unit. Instead, until the end of the phase add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
seizetheprize.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army has been selected to Advance.

TARGET: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Do not make an Advance roll for your unit. Instead, until the end of the phase add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
seizetheprize.flavour: After locating targets of opportunity, the Red Corsairs pursue them with shocking speed and relentless determination.

reaversflurry.name: REAVERS’ FLURRY
reaversflurry.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn.
reaversflurry.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
reaversflurry.text:
WHEN: Your Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
reaversflurry.flavour: The Red Corsairs excel in the furious violence of melee combat, butchering outmatched foes in a lethal flurry of steel.

tothefavouredthespoils.name: TO THE FAVOURED THE SPOILS
tothefavouredthespoils.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
tothefavouredthespoils.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.
tothefavouredthespoils.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
tothefavouredthespoils.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
tothefavouredthespoils.flavour: Huron and his spies are always watching and judging. Those that strive hardest to reach and destroy the Tyrant’s foes may earn a greater share of the plunder.

encirclingsurge.name: ENCIRCLING SURGE
encirclingsurge.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
encirclingsurge.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that is within 6" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
encirclingsurge.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
encirclingsurge.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that is within 6" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
encirclingsurge.flavour: As the fighting continues, these warriors slip away, moving to outflank and surround the embattled foe.

neveroutgunned.name: NEVER OUTGUNNED
neveroutgunned.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
neveroutgunned.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has just been selected to shoot or fight.
neveroutgunned.effect: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.
neveroutgunned.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has just been selected to shoot or fight.

EFFECT: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.
neveroutgunned.flavour: Centuries of combined combat experience enable these Renegade killers to eliminate any target, bringing down resilient foes by targeting weak points or reducing hordes of enemy infantry to bloody mist with rapid volleys.

vengefuldestruction.name: VENGEFUL DESTRUCTION
vengefuldestruction.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
vengefuldestruction.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY (excluding DAMNED units) or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
vengefuldestruction.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes an attack that targets your Vendetta target, add 1 to the Wound roll.
vengefuldestruction.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY (excluding DAMNED units) or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes an attack that targets your Vendetta target, add 1 to the Wound roll.
vengefuldestruction.flavour: Hatred is a powerful motivator. Those who cross Renegade Space Marines rarely live long enough to regret their actions.

undyinghatred.name: UNDYING HATRED
undyinghatred.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
undyinghatred.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
undyinghatred.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
undyinghatred.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
undyinghatred.flavour: Freed from the Emperor’s yoke, these warriors are motivated only by bitter hatred, channelling their ire into every brutal strike: even their final one.

renegadeclaim.name: RENEGADE CLAIM
renegadeclaim.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
renegadeclaim.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
renegadeclaim.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.

EFFECT: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
renegadeclaim.flavour: Renegades do not relinquish their prizes easily.

corruptedmunitions.name: CORRUPTED MUNITIONS
corruptedmunitions.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit in your army that has just been selected to shoot.
corruptedmunitions.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, improve the Armour Penetration of that attack by 1.
corruptedmunitions.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit in your army that has just been selected to shoot.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, improve the Armour Penetration of that attack by 1.
corruptedmunitions.flavour: Without traditional methods of resupply and rearmament, Renegades must plunder or barter for their ammunition. Whether seized from the holds of captive vessels or acquired from daemonic arms dealers or xenos black marketeers, these munitions are horrifically effective.

reaversreaction.name: REAVERS’ REACTION
reaversreaction.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
reaversreaction.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that was hit by one or more of those attacks.
reaversreaction.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
reaversreaction.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that was hit by one or more of those attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
reaversreaction.flavour: Reacting to incoming fire, traitorous infantry adjust their battle plan without breaking stride, moving to take cover or closing in upon their assailants with vengeance in mind.

empyricdislocation.name: EMPYRIC DISLOCATION
empyricdislocation.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
empyricdislocation.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
empyricdislocation.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
empyricdislocation.restrictions: You cannot target the same unit with the Empyric Dislocation and Armour of Corruption Stratagems in the same phase.
empyricdislocation.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target the same unit with the Empyric Dislocation and Armour of Corruption Stratagems in the same phase.
empyricdislocation.flavour: These warriors have not quite escaped the grip of the Warp, remaining slightly incorporeal in a way that causes enemy fire to pass harmlessly through them.

armourofcorruption.name: ARMOUR OF CORRUPTION
armourofcorruption.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
armourofcorruption.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS or MUTILATORS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
armourofcorruption.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
armourofcorruption.restrictions: You cannot target the same unit with the Armour of Corruption and Empyric Dislocation Stratagems in the same phase.
armourofcorruption.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS or MUTILATORS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target the same unit with the Armour of Corruption and Empyric Dislocation Stratagems in the same phase.
armourofcorruption.flavour: Drawn to the largest and toughest warriors by their inherent sense of might and superiority, overspilling warp energies make their conceit a resilient reality.

warpflicker.name: WARP FLICKER
warpflicker.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS or MUTILATORS unit from your army.
warpflicker.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
warpflicker.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS or MUTILATORS unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
warpflicker.flavour: Momentary flares of empyric energy wreathe this unit, causing them to stutter through time and space more swiftly.

warptainted.name: WARP-TAINTED
warptainted.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS or MUTILATORS unit from your army, within range of an objective marker you control.
warptainted.effect: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
warptainted.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS or MUTILATORS unit from your army, within range of an objective marker you control.

EFFECT: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
warptainted.flavour: Immaterial energies still cling to these warriors like tattered shrouds, leaving sites of significance tainted by their touch and haunted by insubstantial spectres.

siegebreakerstrike.name: SIEGEBREAKER STRIKE
siegebreakerstrike.target: Up to two HERETIC ASTARTES units from your army that were set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and have not been selected to shoot this phase.
siegebreakerstrike.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your units have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.
siegebreakerstrike.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: Up to two HERETIC ASTARTES units from your army that were set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and have not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your units have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.
siegebreakerstrike.flavour: These warriors have drilled relentlessly in the art of laying down murderous fire against dug-in foes the moment they teleport into battle.

portalofspite.name: PORTAL OF SPITE
portalofspite.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and has not declared a charge this phase.
portalofspite.effect: Your unit has +2 to charge rolls.
portalofspite.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and has not declared a charge this phase.

EFFECT: Your unit has +2 to charge rolls.
portalofspite.flavour: The warp rift through which these warriors reach the battlefield has been directed toward chosen prey by a vengeful daemonic entity.

touchofthearkifane.name: TOUCH OF THE ARKIFANE
touchofthearkifane.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
touchofthearkifane.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit is selected to make a Dark Pact, you can select both abilities for that unit’s weapons to gain.
touchofthearkifane.text:
WHEN: Any phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, if your unit is selected to make a Dark Pact, you can select both abilities for that unit’s weapons to gain.
touchofthearkifane.flavour: The blessings of Vashtorr flow through these warriors’ weapons, infusing them with power and mutating them into still-deadlier forms.

balefireboon.name: BALEFIRE BOON
balefireboon.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
balefireboon.target: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
balefireboon.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
balefireboon.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
balefireboon.flavour: Channelling the infernal flames of the soul forges, this unit tears through its victims with blows and blasts that melt the toughest armour.

soultallyoffering.name: SOUL-TALLY OFFERING
soultallyoffering.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
soultallyoffering.target: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
soultallyoffering.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
soultallyoffering.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
soultallyoffering.flavour: Offering up so great a sacrificial victim will surely win favour with the Arkifane, or go some way toward settling the looming debts already incurred to him.

biomechanoidregeneration.name: BIOMECHANOID REGENERATION
biomechanoidregeneration.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).
biomechanoidregeneration.effect: One model in your unit regains up to D3 lost wounds. If your unit has the SOUL FORGE keyword, one model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds instead.
biomechanoidregeneration.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).

EFFECT: One model in your unit regains up to D3 lost wounds. If your unit has the SOUL FORGE keyword, one model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds instead.
biomechanoidregeneration.flavour: Metal and muscle, wire and sinew flow together, reknitting battle damage with sparking clots of repulsive mutant growth.

forgefiresurge.name: FORGE-FIRE SURGE
forgefiresurge.when: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army Advances.
forgefiresurge.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the SOUL FORGE keyword, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced instead.
forgefiresurge.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army Advances.

TARGET: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the SOUL FORGE keyword, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced instead.
forgefiresurge.flavour: Warp-tainted motive force and empyric plasma flows through engine and living entity alike, driving them on even as it scours them from within.

unholyfortitude.name: UNHOLY FORTITUDE
unholyfortitude.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
unholyfortitude.target: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
unholyfortitude.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.
unholyfortitude.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.
unholyfortitude.flavour: Responding swiftly to incoming fire, the bound entity within this daemon engine raises arcane wards to soak up the foe’s fury.

infernalvigour.name: INFERNAL VIGOUR
infernalvigour.target: One friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER/DAEMON unit (excluding KHORNE units).
infernalvigour.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER/DAEMON unit (excluding KHORNE units).

EFFECT: Your unit heals D3+1 wounds.
infernalvigour.flavour: With the unbound energies of the Warp surging through them, this infernal champion heals of their hurts as quickly as the enemy can inflict them.

fleshycurse.name: FLESHY CURSE
fleshycurse.target: One friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit.
fleshycurse.effect:
Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. Roll one D6:

- On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

- On a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

- On a 5-6, that enemy unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds.

These mortal wounds are inflicted by a psychic attack.
fleshycurse.text:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. Roll one D6:

- On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

- On a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

- On a 5-6, that enemy unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds.

These mortal wounds are inflicted by a psychic attack.
fleshycurse.flavour: Chanting words of forbidden power, this heretic witch triggers a ghastly explosion of hypermutation within the bodies of foes, rapidly transforming them into heaving mounds of gibbering meat.

wreathedinwarpflame.name: WREATHED IN WARPFLAME
wreathedinwarpflame.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit is selected to shoot.
wreathedinwarpflame.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].
wreathedinwarpflame.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].
wreathedinwarpflame.flavour: Secondary cantrips blossom out like poisoned flowers from the heart of this sorcerous manifestation, raining mutating flame upon the foe in roiling clouds.

ruinationsbounty.name: RUINATION’S BOUNTY
ruinationsbounty.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit is selected to shoot.
ruinationsbounty.effect:
When your unit uses the Dark Pacts ability, your unit’s ranged attacks have:

- [LETHAL HITS].

- [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
ruinationsbounty.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit.

EFFECT: When your unit uses the Dark Pacts ability, your unit’s ranged attacks have:

- [LETHAL HITS].

- [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
ruinationsbounty.flavour: As the murderous rain of projectiles redoubles and the fires of ruin burn higher, so the favour of the Dark Gods falls upon the architects of this devastation.

snareoffire.name: SNARE OF FIRE
snareoffire.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged HAVOCS unit.
snareoffire.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
snareoffire.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged HAVOCS unit.

TARGET: That HAVOCS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
snareoffire.flavour: Even as the foe attempts to escape the rain of ruination, or to close with the foes so cruelly winnowing their ranks, so these Havocs move to establish new sight lines and draw their victims into an inescapable crossfire.

plungingtalons.name: PLUNGING TALONS
plungingtalons.when: Fight phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.
plungingtalons.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit.
plungingtalons.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.

TARGET: That HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].
plungingtalons.flavour: With a last-second blast of speed from their jump packs, the Chaos Space Marines slam into their enemies blades-first.

rakingpass.name: RAKING PASS
rakingpass.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
rakingpass.target: That HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit.
rakingpass.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.
rakingpass.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit is selected to make a fall-back move.

TARGET: That HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit.

EFFECT: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.
rakingpass.flavour: Surging in and out of the enemy lines on wings of dark fire, these predatory killers wreak bloody havoc.

warptwistedterrors.name: WARP-TWISTED TERRORS
warptwistedterrors.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WARP TALONS unit ends a move.
warptwistedterrors.effect: Select one visible enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) within 9" of your unit. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
warptwistedterrors.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WARP TALONS unit ends a move.

TARGET: That WARP TALONS unit.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) within 9" of your unit. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
warptwistedterrors.flavour: So hideous and otherworldly have many Warp Talons been rendered by the energies of the Warp, that merely to look upon their approach is enough to scare the enemy out of their minds.

inveteratemurderers.name: INVETERATE MURDERERS
inveteratemurderers.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that has not been selected to fight this phase.
inveteratemurderers.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is less than or equal to the Toughness characteristic of the target, add 1 to the Wound roll.
inveteratemurderers.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is less than or equal to the Toughness characteristic of the target, add 1 to the Wound roll.
inveteratemurderers.flavour: So long have these warriors fought and killed their way across the galaxy that they have become experts in finding the weak spots of even the hardiest foes.

lowcunning.name: LOW CUNNING
lowcunning.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
lowcunning.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
lowcunning.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
lowcunning.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
lowcunning.flavour: Disabused of such notions as honour or self-sacrifice, Chaos Space Marines use every trick and cunning ruse to ensure their own survival.

nextprize.name: NEXT PRIZE
nextprize.when: Your Command phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army has Secured an objective marker, or your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army has opened a Hatchway.
nextprize.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3". If this Stratagem is used in your Movement phase, at least one model from your unit must end that move on the opposite side of the Hatchway from the one it started the phase on.
nextprize.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army has Secured an objective marker, or your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army has opened a Hatchway.

TARGET: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3". If this Stratagem is used in your Movement phase, at least one model from your unit must end that move on the opposite side of the Hatchway from the one it started the phase on.
nextprize.flavour: The Long Waris gruelling and requires endless captured materiel to wage. Thus this warband are forever searching for the next cache of arms or riches to loot with rapacious eagerness.

cruelexecution.name: CRUEL EXECUTION
cruelexecution.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).
cruelexecution.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.
cruelexecution.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.
cruelexecution.flavour: Veteran killers all, these warriors will exploit the slightest enemy misstep to simply move back and gun their victims down in cold blood.

infernalaltars.name: INFERNAL ALTARS
infernalaltars.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
infernalaltars.target: One DAMNED unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
infernalaltars.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if your unit is within range of an objective marker, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against that attack. If your unit has the CULTIST MOB keyword, models in it have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against that attack instead.
infernalaltars.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DAMNED unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if your unit is within range of an objective marker, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against that attack. If your unit has the CULTIST MOB keyword, models in it have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against that attack instead.
infernalaltars.flavour: Whether heretical fanes unveiled amidst the rebellion or heaped corpses and votive offerings, these ritual foci lend the faithful supernatural protection.

fleetingmight.name: FLEETING MIGHT
fleetingmight.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a DAMNED unit from your army makes a Dark Pact.
fleetingmight.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
fleetingmight.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a DAMNED unit from your army makes a Dark Pact.

TARGET: That DAMNED unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
fleetingmight.flavour: For one tantalising instant, the dark prayers of these fanatics are answered by some infernal warp patron, placing the power to slay champions in their hands.

crudesabotage.name: CRUDE SABOTAGE
crudesabotage.target: One CULTIST MOB or DAMNED CHARACTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
crudesabotage.effect: Select one closed Hatchway within 1“ of your unit. Your unit can attempt to operate that Hatchway.
crudesabotage.restrictions: Until the end of the turn, your unit cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again.
crudesabotage.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One CULTIST MOB or DAMNED CHARACTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Select one closed Hatchway within 1“ of your unit. Your unit can attempt to operate that Hatchway.

RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, your unit cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again.
crudesabotage.flavour: Using charged rigged from scavenged junk and pollutant runoff, the fanatical masses blast open the hatchways that bar their paths to ascension.

stormthebridge.name: STORM THE BRIDGE!
stormthebridge.target: One DAMNED or CHAOS SPAWN unit from your army.
stormthebridge.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stormthebridge.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One DAMNED or CHAOS SPAWN unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stormthebridge.flavour: Seizing their opportunity to strike a fatal blow against those who have oppressed them for so long - and please the Dark Gods in the process - these heretics surge forwards with zealous ferocity.

imperiousadvance.name: IMPERIOUS ADVANCE
imperiousadvance.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
imperiousadvance.effect: Select any number of models in your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the selected models, and each time you select targets for attacks made by those models, they must target an enemy unit that is wholly on the opposite side of a Hatchway from them.
imperiousadvance.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Select any number of models in your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the selected models, and each time you select targets for attacks made by those models, they must target an enemy unit that is wholly on the opposite side of a Hatchway from them.
imperiousadvance.flavour: Attempting to bar the path of these chosen warriors only fills them with a cruel and arrogant desire to crush those who stand in their way.

malignwill.name: MALIGN WILL
malignwill.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
malignwill.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
malignwill.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit takes a Leadership test for the Dark Pacts ability, subtract 1 from the result and, if passed, select one objective marker within 6" of your unit. If there are no enemy units within range of that objective marker (excluding Battle-shocked units], that objective marker is Secured by your army.
malignwill.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit takes a Leadership test for the Dark Pacts ability, subtract 1 from the result and, if passed, select one objective marker within 6" of your unit. If there are no enemy units within range of that objective marker (excluding Battle-shocked units], that objective marker is Secured by your army.
malignwill.flavour: These warriors' will to conquer and despoil is so great that it manifests through the dark power of the warp into a corporeal blight upon realspace.

infernalpatrons.name: INFERNAL PATRONS
infernalpatrons.when: Any phase, just after your opponent targets a unit from their army with a Stratagem.
infernalpatrons.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army within 3" of and visible to that enemy unit.
infernalpatrons.effect: That enemy unit must take a Leadership test; if failed, that usage of that Stratagem has no effect (your opponent cannot use that Stratagem again this phase).
infernalpatrons.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after your opponent targets a unit from their army with a Stratagem.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army within 3" of and visible to that enemy unit.

EFFECT: That enemy unit must take a Leadership test; if failed, that usage of that Stratagem has no effect (your opponent cannot use that Stratagem again this phase).
infernalpatrons.flavour: Many chosen warriors of the Dark Gods have forged pacts with minor daemonic entities, gaining their insidious aid to terrify and disorient the foe in battle.

aggressivestrike.name: AGGRESSIVE STRIKE
aggressivestrike.target: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that arrived using the Deep Strike ability this turn.
aggressivestrike.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
aggressivestrike.restrictions: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.
aggressivestrike.text:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that arrived using the Deep Strike ability this turn.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.
aggressivestrike.flavour: Veterans of countless teleport assaults, these warriors burst from the warp already striding, firing and bellowing praise to the Dark Gods
